summary: Recorded a second worker-level termination path: the engine's apply loop calls node.handleTask and panics immediately when it returns an error, so a state machine whose Update fails ends the process from the apply worker instead of producing a rejected or failed request result. Cited the apply-loop and node event sources, stated the conditions, and made no defect claim since terminating on state machine errors is a plausible deliberate policy. No execution this turn.
